# GitHub Templates

This directory contains GitHub-specific templates and configuration files for the TopoGPT3 project.

## Contents

### Issue Templates

Located in [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/):

- **Bug report** ([bug_report.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md)): Standard template for reporting bugs with reproduction steps, expected behavior, and environment details.
- **Feature request** ([feature_request.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md)): Template for proposing new features or enhancements.
- **Custom issue** ([custom.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/custom.md)): Generic template for issues that do not fit the bug or feature categories.

### Pull Request Template

Located in [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/):

- **Pull request template** ([pull_request_template.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/pull_request_template.md)): Standard format for submitting changes, including description, motivation, and checklists.

### Configuration

- **dependabot.yml**: Configures automated dependency updates via Dependabot.

## Usage

When opening an issue or pull request on GitHub, the appropriate template will be suggested automatically based on the file structure in this directory.

## Contributing

If you want to improve these templates, edit the relevant files and submit a pull request following the existing template guidelines.
